breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly instructed to use rpm directly for angular velocity (ω). The Agent corrected this by explicitly stating the formula to convert rpm to rad/s: 'ω = 2π × (1200 / 60) rad/s'. This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
